dump_clip_features_pascal_part: dump CLIP text features for PASCAL-PART categories and save to a numpy file
generate_dog_part_features: generate CLIP text features only for dog part categories using the --only_dog flag
customize_clip_prompt_template: customize CLIP prompt templates with options like 'a', 'none', 'photo', or 'scene'
select_clip_model_variant: select a specific CLIP model variant such as ViT-B/32 for feature extraction
save_clip_features_to_npy: save extracted CLIP text features as a numpy array to a specified output path
